note: Small worked example: a 14 s opening with original assets.
premise: In this world, every baby is handed a ticket, and you wait your whole life for your number.

lines.text: In this world, every baby is handed a ticket, and you wait your whole life for your number.
You see, the sign hangs over the square. "Now serving seven."
It has said seven for 200 years.
Nobody knows what you get when you're served.
The stories say number one asked for a crown and got a crown.
Number two asked for a boat.
